Class User

java.lang.Object
project.models.actors.User
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, JournalObserver
Direct Known Subclasses:
Employee, ResearcherDecorator, Student
public abstract class User extends Object implements Serializable, JournalObserver
Abstract base for all users in the KBTU system. Implements JournalObserver so any user can subscribe to research journals. Serializable for persistence via the Singleton Database.
